joinKey: sourceAlias + 1-based response ordinal within alias; exact alias+text multiset matching is applied before ordinal fallback

classificationSemantics.sameAliasSameText: same frozen raw proposal; downstream/runtime is the remaining suspect for any final-score difference
classificationSemantics.modelTextDrift: same alias slot exists but quoted text differs
classificationSemantics.aliasPresentAbsent: old alias has unmatched raw proposal and new has no corresponding slot
classificationSemantics.newExtraAlias: new alias has unmatched raw proposal
